profiling_contract.aggregation_required: Aggregate every CUDA Graph node in the NVTX range; a single kernel RooflineChart does not represent the split pipeline.
profiling_contract.logical_traffic_scope: Each checkpoint reference models only its first internal step and is not an aggregate-byte estimate for the full replay.

initial_internal_step_logical_traffic_re.scope: checkpoint state before internal step 1 only
checkpoint state before internal step 1 only
checkpoint state before internal step 1 only

shallow_engine_graph_tensor_storage.scope: Unique backing storage for tensors directly owned by the engine, its canonical graph, and the graph wrapper at construction time. Excludes checkpoint state/age staging, tensors nested in containers or model objects, CUDA Graph/private pools, compiler workspaces, and allocator reservation; this is not total GPU residency.

workload.graph_semantics: seeded exact-simple undirected circulant built directly in CSR; not a uniform random-regular sample; shared row offsets give it more regular/coalesced adjacency access than a randomly labelled regular graph

warmup_policy.phase_order: finish priming calls, then start a fresh duration clock
warmup_policy.synchronization: before priming and after every target call
